findings.note: Code-only. Neither printed clause moves a number (one suspends Demoralize's own 'you lose hidden' rider, the other waives its no-shared-language penalty), so the carrier is a FEAT_SITUATIONAL entry in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts on the Intimidation row - the same shape as the language clause on intimidating-prowess. No data field exists that could say either thing.

Code-only DELETION. feats/monk-moves already carries speedsIf [{unarmored:true,speeds:{land:10}}] (itself an effect-backfill row) and derive.ts evaluates it from the character's own armour, so the registry star advertised the identical +10 a second time. The star is removed from src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts and 'monk-moves' added to the handEdited exclusion set in scripts/apply-situational-lane.mjs so the generated lane cannot re-emit it. The DATA is already correct - no row.

Code-only. A waived circumstance penalty has no numeric carrier (the penalty is never on our sheet to subtract), so it is a display FEAT_SITUATIONAL entry on the perception row, the same shape as brilliant-vision / ash-piercing-gaze. Only the Perception half is authored: murksight#attack was REFUTED, so no strikeAttack target was added.

backfillRows.why: AoN feat-6238 (Player Core 2 p.182): "You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds; this increases to a +10-foot status bonus while you have panache." The +5 is ALWAYS ON, so per the owner's speed ruling it is a number, not a star; derive.ts reads it via landBonusOf(db.feats[f.featId]?.landSpeedBonus), the same lane classFeatures/vivacious-speed uses for its own always-on half. The panache step stays the star in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts. New field on this record - no existing effect-backfill row for feats/swashbucklers-speed, so no supersedes.

findings.note: One row plus a star trim. Before this the whole mechanic was a star that moved nothing, so a swashbuckler-archetype character's Speed never changed with or without panache.
